title: Audit current pipeline against the full-send readiness gate
doing: Perform a source/receipt-only gap audit of live simulator carry-over, scheduler/normalizer/averaging checkpoint state, full per-update PPO telemetry, evaluation isolation, fresh-stream exclusions, clocks and strict lifecycle. Compare generic code with the actual DODGE-013 journal path; no model loading, fixtures, games or training.
expected: Source-informed expectation: fresh-env checkpointing abandons live games, generic PPO computes some required metrics that the formal worker drops, and scheduler/full-state restore support is incomplete. Existing learner/RNG and strict resource/exact-once controls should be reusable, but source preparation cannot qualify the new long run.

evidence.label: User-directed long-run gate; no launch authority
